subject.title: refactor(ui): redesign channels DM access requests, drop channel-health JSON card

question: Should the raw Channel health JSON diagnostic be removed from the operator-facing Channels page while this PR also carries the narrow Codex test-shard routing repair?
rationale: The UI change is intentional and visually proven, but removing an existing diagnostic surface and combining it with automation routing requires maintainer acceptance beyond a mechanical patch review.

options.title: Approve the scoped cleanup
options.body: Accept the removal as an intentional product decision after confirming the final test shard schedules the prewarm test once.

options.title: Keep a supported diagnostic path
options.body: Retain or replace the health snapshot with a maintainer-approved troubleshooting surface before merging the UI cleanup.

options.title: Split the automation repair
options.body: Move the test-shard correction into its own focused PR if separate review ownership is preferred.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped cleanup
recommendation.body: Accept the removal as an intentional product decision after confirming the final test shard schedules the prewarm test once.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch owns the Channels UI direction and its mock-flow proof.
